description: This file defines a package 'flowrate' implementing rate-limited io.Reader and io.Writer with associated interfaces and methods for controlling data transfer rates.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: A rate-limited implementation of io.ReadCloser with methods to control transfer rate and blocking behavior.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: A rate-limited implementation of io.WriteCloser with methods to control transfer rate and blocking behavior.

methods.name: NewReader
methods.description: Creates a new rate-limited Reader with specified limit.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into p without exceeding the rate limit.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a new transfer rate limit.

methods.name: SetBlocking
methods.description: Sets blocking behavior for the Reader.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying reader if it implements io.Closer.

methods.name: NewWriter
methods.description: Creates a new rate-limited Writer with specified limit.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from p without exceeding the rate limit.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a new transfer rate limit.

methods.name: SetBlocking
methods.description: Sets blocking behavior for the Writer.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying writer if it implements io.Closer.
